name: Palo Alto Networks
description: Connect your own PAN-OS firewall(s) and/or Panorama management server to manage security rules, address/service objects, zones, interfaces, device groups, managed devices, templates, and commit/ push operations from Imperal -- plus bulk operations and a Palo Alto estate health audit. Uses your own PAN-OS/Panorama credentials, exchanged once for an API key via the standard keygen endpoint -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_panos
tools.description: Connect a PAN-OS firewall by saving its host and admin credentials, after exchanging them once for an API key.

username.description: PAN-OS administrator username (used once to obtain an API key via keygen).
username.title: Username

password.description: PAN-OS administrator password (used once, not stored).
password.title: Password

label.description: Optional friendly name for this PAN-OS connection.
label.title: Label
